calibration.familywise_unit: Maximum over all pairs and all three feature channels within one fixed-horizon campaign; empirical calibration only. Small campaign count does not establish a low false-positive rate.

reference.score_definition: Maximum positive standardized increase over the same pair clean reference; scale=max(0.05,1.4826*MAD). No strict threshold above a bounded raw similarity.
